 CBehaviorValues
 CVictoryComponent
 CBehaviorAdvance
 CBehaviorAssaultWallsAttack enemy on or through the walls and gates and push into the castle
 CBehaviorCautiousAdvance
 CBehaviorCavalryScreenFormation screens enemy cavalry trying to move around main infantry
 CBehaviorCharge
 CBehaviorComponent
 CBehaviorDefendFormation tries to maintain position and fend off attackers Either a single world position is given to defend or a tactical position object can be given to defend If neither is given formation is expected to defend where they stand
 CBehaviorDefendCastleKeyPositionDefend castle walls and gates
 CBehaviorDefendKeyPositionFormation tries to stay between enemy and the position to defend at the most advantageous position available
 CBehaviorDefendSiegeWeaponFormation tries to maintain position and defend siege weapon it is expected to defend
 CBehaviorDefensiveRingFormation tries to maintain position and fend off attackers
 CBehaviorDestroySiegeWeaponsDestroy enemy siege weapons
 CBehaviorEliminateEnemyInsideCastleEliminate enemy formation inside castle
 CBehaviorFireFromInfantryCoverFormation tries to maintain position and fend off attackers
 CBehaviorFlankMove to a position that will threaten the enemy
 CBehaviorGeneralOnly the commander's special formation is supposed to use this, stays in back of army, tries to stay alive
 CBehaviorHoldHighGroundFind a good defensive position and hold it
 CBehaviorHorseArcherSkirmish
 CBehaviorMountedSkirmishGo in an ellipse around the enemy, always keeping them to your left to shoot from horseback
 CBehaviorProtectFlankFormation stays to sides of main formation to protect its flank
 CBehaviorProtectGeneralOnly special general's bodyguard formation is supposed to use this, protects general
 CBehaviorPullBackRun away from most dangerous enemy and strafe towards average ally position if possible
 CBehaviorRegroupReassemble and reform
 CBehaviorReserveFormation order position for other behaviors were unavailable, so formation trails behind rest of army or stays behind
 CBehaviorRetakeCastleKeyPositionRetake a lost defensive lane
 CBehaviorRetreat
 CBehaviorRetreatToCastleRetreat into castle walls in sally out
 CBehaviorRetreatToKeepRetreat to keep during siege
 CBehaviorSallyOutOpen gates, sally out of the castle and take out the enemy
 CBehaviorScreenedSkirmishRanged formation stays behind main formation for side and shoots at the enemy
 CBehaviorSergeantMPInfantryFormation engages enemy formations that are not mounted when nearby, otherwise goes to nearest flag position
 CBehaviorSergeantMPLastFlagLastStandBehavior selected when mission is about to end and we are losing, get to the last flag and fight in melee
 CBehaviorSergeantMPMountedFormation goes to and captures uncontested flag positions and attacks enemy formations if they are near and vulnerable
 CBehaviorSergeantMPMountedRangedFormation goes to and captures uncontested flag positions and skirmishes with enemy if they are nearby unless they are archers in which case they charge them
 CBehaviorSergeantMPRangedFormation covers ally infantry formations if any, otherwise skirmishes and goes to a flag position
 CBehaviorShootFromCastleWallsArchers shoot from castle walls, towers and battlements
 CBehaviorShootFromCliffFormation tries to stay on a spot good for archers and disperse to shooting positions if available Either a single world position is given to stay at or a tactical position object can be given to defend If neither is given formation is expected to stay where they stand
 CBehaviorShootFromSiegeTowerRanged units shoot from the siege tower
 CBehaviorSkirmishApproach most suitable target up to a certain point, but do not go any nearer
 CBehaviorSkirmishBehindFormationRanged formation stays behind referenceFormation and shoots at the enemy
 CBehaviorSkirmishLineRanged formation stays in front of main formation for side and shoots at the enemy as they approach
 CBehaviorSparseSkirmishRanged soldiers move to positions marked in scene for advantageous shooting
 CBehaviorStop
 CBehaviorTacticalCharge
 CBehaviorUseMurderHoleSoldiers use murder hole to throw rocks and shoot at the enemies below
 CBehaviorUseSiegeMachinesUse primary siege weapons to open ways over/through the walls
 CBehaviorVanguard(Cavalry)Formation stays in front of main infantry block
 CBehaviorWaitForLaddersWait at ready to use ladders or to burst through a breach in the wall as heavier siege weapons approach
